content: Snipe-IT daily manager features (verified on official product page): one-click checkin/checkout, transfers between users, pre-defined kits, optional digital signature on acceptance (EULA), QR code labels generated from listing checkboxes with size specs, email alerts for expiring warranties/licenses, expected-checkin report, low-inventory report, recent-activity dashboard, calendar view, mobile-friendly updates, quick asset auditing, CSV import/export.
